title: Rooftop Jazz in Two Formats
tests: Checks delivery of two correctly composed aspect-ratio variants with matching event content, readable overlays and no letterboxing.

faults.what: Only one 10-second portrait video is delivered; the required separate 16:9 venue-screen version is missing.
The location misspells Manchester as 'Mansether' throughout the sampled frames.
An unwanted fourth text line reads 'Sky Turacce, 2026', adding garbled and confusing event information.

judge.summary: The portrait clip shows sunset rooftop musicians, but incorrect location text, an extra garbled line and the missing landscape version require a redo.

must_haves.item: Two separate playable videos are delivered, each 10 seconds long: one 9:16 and one 16:9.
must_haves.why: Only one 10-second video is supplied, with portrait frames.

must_haves.item: Both versions show rooftop musicians at sunset with consistent styling and event content.
must_haves.why: The supplied portrait clip shows consistently styled rooftop musicians at sunset, but no second version is delivered.

must_haves.item: Both versions display exactly 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'.
must_haves.why: The title and date are correct, but Manchester is misspelled and the landscape version is absent.

must_haves.item: All three text lines are fully inside each frame and readable together for at least 3 seconds.
must_haves.why: The visible overlays remain inside the portrait frame across the samples, but the required correct location line never appears and no landscape version is supplied.

must_haves.item: Both compositions fill their frames without black bars, stretched imagery or cropped-off musicians' faces.
must_haves.why: The supplied portrait composition fills its frame without visible bars, stretching or cropped faces, but the required landscape composition is missing.

must_haves.item: Both videos contain mellow jazz and no voiceover.
must_haves.why: The sound report confirms no clear speech in the supplied clip, but does not establish mellow jazz; there is no second video to assess.
